- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Quesadillas - Tortillas filled with cheese (and sometimes other ingredients like chicken or beans), then cooked until the cheese is melted and the tortilla is crispy. Recipe: <https://www.delish.com/cooking/recipe-ideas/a22565432/quesadilla-recipe/>
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tamales - Corn dough filled with meat, cheese, or vegetables, then steamed in a corn husk. Recipe: <https://www.mexicoinmykitchen.com/how-to-make-tamales/>
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sopaipillas - Fried dough served with honey or cinnamon sugar. Recipe: <https://www.allrecipes.com/recipe/20590/sopaipillas/>
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Carne Asada - Grilled beef marinated in lime juice, garlic, and spices. Recipe: <https://www.food.com/recipe/authentic-mexican-carne-asada-159141>
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Churros - Fried dough coated in cinnamon sugar, often served with a side of chocolate sauce for dipping. Recipe: <https://www.biggerbolderbaking.com/homemade-churros/>
